description.value: Boiling Point is a Taiwanese hot soup specialty restaurant chain serving individual hot pot meals cooked at the table, with a wide range of broth bases from Taiwanese spicy to Korean bean paste to Milk Cream Curry. The Vancouver Main Street location is part of a chain with three Canadian outlets and outposts across the US and Japan. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down meal with substantial protein and vegetarian options, plus takeout availability.
